reason: The unchanged single-thread worker takes approximately 0.48 CPU seconds per complete joint null trial. Independent predeclared null stress cases may use otherwise idle CPUs rather than unnecessarily executing all required cases serially.
supersedes_only: Serial case scheduling in execution_order; no statistical element.
scheduling_law: Allow concurrent unchanged workers for predeclared complete null cases, up to eight CPUs. Persist each completed raw case before interpretation. If ANY complete case fails any frozen gate, interrupt all remaining jobs and stop. Interrupted jobs are not certification evidence and are not restarted in this task. Power starts only after ALL required null/support gates pass.
